messages:
tia: heads up — noticed ~2% of service accounts were deactivated after last night's key rewrap. SCIM reports show 204s from Okta but our audit logs don't have the KMS envelope-id for those ops. filing as P1? :thinking_face:
nate: yikes. did the rewrap job target the dedicated-key alias or the fallback alias?
maria: rewrap targeted alias redwood-prod-kms-v2 at 02:13 UTC. rotation job logs look OK for most tenants, but I see a handful of `decrypt` failures in the scim-provisioner around 02:14:36. snippet:
```
2026-03-22T02:14:36.123Z scim-provisioner ERROR tenant=acme decrypt failed err="missing envelope metadata" svc=provisioner request_id=req_1a2b3c
2026-03-22T02:14:36.124Z scim-provisioner WARN tenant=acme fallback to noop-deprov
```
alex: can you paste the exact SCIM payload for one of the affected svcacct deprovs? we need to check `externalId` vs `id` mismatch.
tia: here's a redacted example: `{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"id":"svc-1234","userName":"svc-ci-agent","active":false}`
ops-bot: deploy-bot: release/infra/2026.03.22 applied to staging at 02:05 UTC :rocket:

maria: also digging into KMS logs — looks like the new envelope format included `env_version:2` metadata. the provisioner expects `env_id` field instead. so our audit joiner that augments SCIM events with KMS metadata failed to annotate those deprovs.
nate: that would explain missing envelope-id in audit, and downstream logic treated the missing metadata as tamper -> deprov. can we confirm whether this affected only service accounts or also user accounts?
maria: quick grep: 18 events flagged, 15 are service accounts, 3 user accounts (non-prod). pattern: all created before 2025-11 and never rewrapped until yesterday.
tia: ok. immediate plan: 1) pause any further rewraps for alias redwood-prod-kms-v2 (rollback trigger) 2) run a backfill that maps env_version:2 -> env_id for affected events 3) open Okta case if we see 4xxs beyond our retry window.
alex: agree. I'll open infra-incident and assign action items. alex -> triage owner, tia -> audit/backfill, nate -> kms/rewrap rollback.
idp-bot: ticket created: INF-2026-314 (okta/scim deprovision after kms-rewrap) assigned to @alex.

maria: small repro command to fetch a failing event payload from ELK:
```
curl -s "https://elk.internal/_search?q=request_id:req_1a2b3c&size=1" | jq '.hits.hits[0]._source'
```

nate: minimal mitigation script to avoid deprovs until backfill runs (pseudo):
```
# skip deprovision if envelope-id missing
if event.kms.envelope_id == null then
  requeue_event(event)
else
  apply_deprov(event)
end
```

tia: FYI I already added a short-lived feature flag in front of provisioner to requeue when envelope metadata absent. turned it on at 02:50 UTC. monitoring now.

maria: monitoring update: no additional deprovs since flag enabled. alerting to SLO channel for 30m, then we can run backfill.

alex: thanks team. next steps in INF-2026-314: postmortem owner = maria, timeline and root cause by EOD. @nate please follow-up with KMS team on envelope naming compatibility and add a compatibility test in nightly CI. :white_check_mark:

nate: noted. I'll also add a quick unit test that rejects new envelope formats without a mapping shim.

tia: filed Okta support ticket as well: OKTA-88921 (partial SCIM 204s during deprov retries). included logs.

maria: adding final note — vuln triage: no evidence of malicious activity, appears to be a compatibility regression from the rewrap job. marking as operational incident not security incident for now.

alex: closing loop — we'll keep incident open until backfill completes and we validate audit joiner annotations for the rewrapped range. thanks all :pray:
